conceptual assets.concept: GPIO output value stored in port_out and presented on gpio_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus write flow updates port_out on writes to addr_out_c: "when addr_out_c => port_out <= bus_req_i.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0);" reset sets port_out <= (others => '0'); the output_stage drives gpio_o(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0) <= port_out. Corrupting the stored value or its exported port would change the driven GPIO outputs, violating the implemented output state.

conceptual assets.concept: Sampled GPIO input state captured from gpio_i into port_in
conceptual assets.reasoning: The input sampling flow registers gpio_i into port_in on the clock: "port_in <= gpio_i(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0)" (input_stage). port_in is returned on bus read at addr_in_c: "when addr_in_c => bus_rsp_o.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0) <= port_in" and is used by irq_trigger logic. Corrupting the sampled value or its source would alter reads and IRQ decisions.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-pin IRQ trigger decision computed into irq_trig
conceptual assets.reasoning: The generate block computes irq_trig(i) from irq_typ(i), irq_pol(i), port_in(i) and port_in2(i): sel_v := irq_typ(i) & irq_pol(i); case sel_v sets irq_trig(i) to expressions such as not port_in(i), port_in(i), (not port_in(i)) and port_in2(i), etc. irq_trig is used by irq_buffer to set pending bits: "irq_pend <= irq_en and ((irq_pend and irq_clrn) or irq_trig)". Corrupting the trigger decisions would change pending interrupts.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-pin interrupt-pending flags stored in irq_pend
conceptual assets.reasoning: The irq_buffer process updates irq_pend on clock: "irq_pend <= irq_en and ((irq_pend and irq_clrn) or irq_trig)" and reset clears irq_pend <= (others => '0'). irq_pend is returned on bus read at addr_ip_c: "when addr_ip_c => bus_rsp_o.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0) <= irq_pend" and drives cpu_irq_o via reduction. Corrupting irq_pend would change CPU-visible interrupt state.

conceptual assets.concept: CPU interrupt output signal driven from irq_pend
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_buffer drives the module output cpu_irq_o from irq_pend on clock: "cpu_irq_o <= or_reduce_f(irq_pend)" and reset sets cpu_irq_o <= '0'. Corrupting cpu_irq_o would change the interrupt presented to the CPU.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-pin IRQ enable mask stored in irq_en
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_en is written by bus writes: "when addr_ie_c => irq_en <= bus_req_i.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0);" and is used in irq_buffer to gate pending updates: "irq_pend <= irq_en and ((...))". Corrupting irq_en changes which events produce pending interrupts.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-pin IRQ type configuration stored in irq_typ
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_typ is programmed by bus writes: "when addr_tt_c => irq_typ <= bus_req_i.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0);" and used by irq_trigger to select trigger behavior (sel_v := irq_typ(i) & irq_pol(i)). Corrupting irq_typ changes how events are detected.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-pin IRQ polarity configuration stored in irq_pol
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_pol is programmed by bus writes: "when addr_tp_c => irq_pol <= bus_req_i.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0);" and used by irq_trigger in sel_v := irq_typ(i) & irq_pol(i). Corrupting irq_pol changes trigger polarity and detected events.

conceptual assets.concept: Per-pin IRQ clear mask stored in irq_clrn
conceptual assets.reasoning: irq_clrn is driven to all ones each clock by default in the bus_access process (irq_clrn <= (others => '1')) and can be written via "when addr_ip_c => irq_clrn <= bus_req_i.data(GPIO_NUM-1 downto 0);". irq_buffer uses irq_clrn to clear pending bits: "(irq_pend and irq_clrn)". Corrupting irq_clrn would alter clearing behavior of pending interrupts.
